# telnyx_ai_collection_sources (Data Source)

Lists ai collection sources, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_ai_collection_source`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `collection_id` (String) The collection id.

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `ai_collection_sources` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ai_collection_sources))

<a id="nestedatt--ai_collection_sources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ai_collection_sources`

Read-Only:

- `bucket_id` (String) The Telnyx Storage bucket name. Present only for `bucket` sources.
- `collection_id` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the record type. Always `ai_collection_source`.
- `source_type` (String) The type of Telnyx data attached as a source. `bucket` requires an additional `bucket_id`. Only `voice` is searchable today; `meeting_bot`, `message`, and `bucket` attach but are not yet searchable (Coming soon).
- `status` (String)
